data: Which method shows the highest ALO value at pp=0.5?

The caption states that at pp = 0.57, ALO is reduced from 0.92 to 0.89 when using contraction hedges. The caption also states that at pp = 0.45, expansion hedges reduce the minimum ALO from 0.1 for unhedged assertions to 0.02 for expansion hedged assertions. From this information, we can infer that at pp = 0.5, the unhedged assertion has the highest ALO value among the three methods. Therefore, the answer is "Unhedged".
